q.t: Each rakhi needs 2 threads. How many threads are needed for 5 rakhis?
Find 5 × 4.
A box has 3 rows of 3 laddoos. How many laddoos?
18 laddoos are shared equally among 9 people. How many does each get?
q.e: Give one each to 9 people (9 used), then one more each (18 used): 2 each.

q.t: Find 20 ÷ 5.
q.e: 20 shared equally into 5 plates gives 4 on each, because 5 × 4 = 20.

q.t: Each cycle needs 2 wheels. How many cycles can get wheels from 12 wheels?
q.e: Take away 2 wheels for each cycle: 12 → 10 → 8 → 6 → 4 → 2 → 0, that is 6 cycles.

q.t: 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 is the same as:
q.e: Six fours added together is 6 times 4.

q.t: Skip jumping by 3: 3, 6, 9, ___. What comes next?
A chicken has 2 legs. How many legs do 5 chickens have?
16 kaju katlis are shared equally among 4 people. How many does each get?
A flower bed has 8 rows with 6 plants in each row. How many plants?
An idli stand has 6 plates and each plate makes 4 idlis. How many idlis in one go?
30 cookies are shared equally among 5 children. How many does each child get?
Roro starts at 0 and takes 6 equal jumps to reach 18. How big is each jump?
Suma saves ₹8 every day. After how many days will she have ₹56?
Find 7 × 6.
Find 32 ÷ 8.
Skip jumping: 32, 40, 48, 56, ___. What comes next?
Find 45 ÷ 5.
A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 5 spiders have?
Each wheel of a toy rath needs 5 spokes. How many spokes do 20 wheels need?
Find 30 × 5.
q.e: Three groups of 10 wheels, each needing 50 spokes: 50 + 50 + 50 = 150.

q.t: One wall-hanging costs ₹42. How much do two cost?
A group of spiders has 32 legs. Each spider has 8 legs. How many spiders?
Auto-rickshaws in a garage have 36 wheels. Each has 3 wheels. How many autos?
Micky the mouse sees 48 cow legs in a shed. How many cows are there?
q.e: Each cow has 4 legs: 10 cows have 40 legs and 2 more have 8, so 12 cows.

q.t: Mary has 63 sea-shells. She gives 7 to each of her 5 friends. How many does she have left?
A frog starts at 0 and jumps only in 7s. What is the biggest number it lands on before crossing 50?
How many ₹50 notes make ₹500?
q.e: Two ₹50 notes make ₹100, and ₹500 is five hundreds: 5 × 2 = 10.

q.t: Without working it out, what is the last digit of 23 × 5?
q.e: In the 5 times table, 5 times an odd number ends in 5, and 5 times an even number ends in 0. 23 is odd.

q.t: Karry the crow sees 24 horns of cows in a shed. Each cow has 2 horns and 4 legs. How many legs are in the shed?
One rabdi cup costs ₹75. Preeti buys 5 cups and pays with ₹100 notes only. How many ₹100 notes must she give?
q.e: 5 × 75 = 375. Three notes (₹300) are not enough, so she gives 4 notes (₹400).

q.t: Preeti pays ₹400 for 5 rabdi cups that cost ₹75 each. How much change does she get?
Dhruv has 112 shells. Each necklace uses 28 shells. How many necklaces can he make?
q.e: Keep taking away 28: 112 → 84 → 56 → 28 → 0. That is 4 necklaces.

q.t: Kannu needs 17 shells for each necklace. She has 100 shells. How many full necklaces can she make?
q.e: 5 necklaces use 85 shells. A 6th would need 102, which is more than 100.

q.t: Dhara’s family has 9 people and each should get 4 jalebis. They have 24. How many more jalebis must they buy?
A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 23 spiders have?
q.e: 20 spiders have 160 legs and 3 spiders have 24: 160 + 24 = 184.

q.t: An auto-rickshaw has 3 wheels. How many wheels do 18 autos have?
q.e: 10 autos have 30 wheels and 8 autos have 24: 30 + 24 = 54.

q.t: There is a line of 55 ants and each ant has 6 legs. How many legs are there?
q.e: 50 ants have 300 legs and 5 ants have 30: 300 + 30 = 330.

q.t: Each rakhi needs 1 flower, 2 threads and 4 beads. There are 30 flowers, 30 threads and 30 beads. How many rakhis can be made?
q.e: Beads run out first: 7 rakhis use 28 beads, and an 8th would need 32.
